    return np.clip(2*(np.asarray(q)-limits[:,0])/(limits[:,1]-limits[:,0])-1,-1,1)

def balance(n=10,label='balance',hip_base=-.55,knee=.8,ankle=-.4):
    r=Robot();obs=r.get_obs(cameras=['room_camera'],video='none'); history=[]
    for _ in range(n):
        p=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now']);pitch=np.arctan2(p[41],-p[43]);roll=-np.arctan2(p[42],-p[43])
        q=np.zeros(19);q[[2,7]]=hip_base+1.0*pitch+.12*p[39];q[[3,8]]=knee;q[[4,9]]=ankle

def Ry(t):
    c,s=np.cos(t),np.sin(t);return np.array([[c,0,s],[0,1,0],[-s,0,c]])
def Rx(t):
    c,s=np.cos(t),np.sin(t);return np.array([[1,0,0],[0,c,-s],[0,s,c]])
def Rz(t):
    c,s=np.cos(t),np.sin(t);return np.array([[c,-s,0],[s,c,0],[0,0,1]])
def rotation(p):
    pitch=np.arctan2(p[41],np.sqrt(p[42]**2+p[43]**2));roll=-np.arctan2(p[42],-p[43]);return Ry(pitch)@Rx(roll)
def foot(q,leg):
    i=leg*5;side=1 if leg==0 else -1
    a=q[i:i+5]; yaw=Rz(a[0]);ro=Rx(a[1]);hi=Ry(a[2]);kn=Ry(a[3]);an=Ry(a[4])
    return np.array([0,side*.087,-.174])+yaw@(np.array([.039,0,0])+ro@(np.array([0,side*.116,0])+hi@(np.array([0,0,-.4])+kn@(np.array([0,0,-.4])+an@np.array([.05,0,-.091])))))
def foot_state(p,leg):
    q=p[:19];f=foot(q,leg);d=(foot(q+p[19:38]*.0001,leg)-f)/.0001
    R=rotation(p);return R@f,-R@(d+np.cross(p[38:41],f))

def drive(n=10,label='drive',ankle=-.5,pitch_des=.04,knee=.8):
    r=Robot();obs=r.get_obs(cameras=['room_camera'],video='none');history=[]
    for _ in range(n):
        p=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now']);pitch=np.arctan2(p[41],-p[43]);roll=-np.arctan2(p[42],-p[43])
        q=np.zeros(19)
        for i in [0,5]:
            q[i+2]=-p[i+3]-p[i+4]-pitch_des+.5*(pitch-pitch_des)+.10*p[39]
            q[i+3]=knee;q[i+4]=ankle;q[i+1]=.8*roll+.10*p[38]
        obs=r.submit('joint_position',normalize(q,r.spec()),cameras=['room_camera'],video='none');history.append({'qtarget':q.tolist(),'meta':obs.meta})
        pp=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now']);print(obs.meta['control_steps'],np.round(pp[38:],3),'v',np.round(foot_state(pp,0)[1],3),'f',np.round(foot_state(pp,0)[0],3))
        if obs.done:break
    record(obs,label);(OUT/(label+'_history.json')).write_text(json.dumps(history));return obs
